fact: DHIS2 says a March 2026 joint WHO and HISP UiO mission found Angola's DHIS2-based national health information system serving more than 4,700 registered users and working as a solid national platform for the Ministry of Health.
Health Minister Silvia Lutucuta said DHIS2 has been implemented as the main national health data management platform, integrating different information platforms and producing analytical dashboards.

The Countdown 2030 report says national routine facility reports run through DHIS2 in Angola, whose 2020-2021 implementation lowered data quality; it gives national completeness of 71% of expected monthly facility reports in 2025, with private sector not reporting and gaps in several provinces.
The report gives national completeness of monthly facility reporting as 71% of expected reports in 2025, 120% in 2024, and 24% of districts at 90% or more in 2025.
